candidates.access_summary: OpenNeuro exposes four N4-corrected MNI152 MRI modalities and one spatially aligned tumor mask as separate versioned S3 objects totaling 24219725 bytes. Three version-pinned metadata files provide license, snapshot, and processing lineage.
assumptions: NIfTI shape, affine, dtype, finite values, and exact cross-file geometry remain unverified until private acquisition.
The dataset's numeric ET remap from 3 to 4 does not by itself prove semantic equivalence of the remaining tumor classes.
The paper cites snapshot v1.0.1. The selected artifact identities come from v2.0.1, whose CHANGES file documents cohort corrections.
The README describes a single N4 derivative directory, while the v2.0.1 Git tree contains a duplicated directory segment. The pinned Git paths are authoritative.
candidates.compatibility_summary: The N4-only derivative provides T1c, T1, T2, and FLAIR without pre-applying z-score normalization. It is registered to MNI152 and skull-stripped. The aligned mask uses values 0, 1, 2, and 3, so only the numeric ET mapping 3 to 4 is known. Full label semantic equivalence, private NIfTI header checks, and model-training overlap remain unresolved.
evidence: OpenNeuro snapshot DOI 10.18112/openneuro.ds007045.v2.0.1 resolves to Git tag 2.0.1 and commit 283007b96977b5b3285bd22cd67b7d97114b1eed.
Git-annex targets at the tagged commit publish SHA-256 and exact byte size for all four MRI objects and the aligned mask.
Independent HEAD requests to all five versioned S3 URLs returned HTTP 200 with matching version IDs, sizes, ETags, and AES256 server-side encryption.
dataset_description.json pins BIDS 1.8.0, CC0, and the v2.0.1 dataset DOI.
The peer-reviewed publication DOI 10.1038/s41597-026-07953-2 states MNI152 registration, skull stripping, N4 correction, mask alignment, expert review, and mask values 0, 1, 2, and 3.
No NIfTI object bytes were transferred during this research.
